inputs.checklistItemText: Tree clearances measured from utility pole centerline or structure instead of from outer electric conductor
inputs.question: On the landscape plan or site plan, are there any dimension lines or notes showing tree clearances to overhead electric facilities? If so, what is being measured - are the dimensions shown from tree trunk location to the outer conductor, or from tree location to pole centerline/structure? Are there any distance annotations visible on the landscape plan?

output.reasoning: The agent is asking whether dimension lines/notes exist on the plan and what they measure (presence and labeling check), not asking for an actual measurement between two features. This is a progressive verification step to identify whether clearance annotations are present and how they are labeled, before any measurement validation would occur.
